description:
dev/studies/b488f02c/feasibility-study.md section 4.4 publishes 18182 for the q=3, n=12, cpu_avx2 composite rate; its own committed artifact dev/studies/b488f02c/throughput-2026-08-07.csv holds 18181.4619, which renders as 18181 at the table's five significant figures. One cell, 0.003% overstatement; the other 34 published q=3 cells round correctly.

## Background

Found by the F_3 receipt campaign (047b62ed) when its analysis.py switched from quoting the study's table to parsing the CSV (commit 61d4bb3d); recorded in the receipts as section 11.1. cpu_avx2 is never the best applicable CPU path at any order, so no baseline ratio depends on the cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The published section 4.4 cell agrees with the committed CSV at the table's stated precision, and the correction commit cites this issue.
- [hard] REQ-02: A recorded check (script or command in the study directory) verifies every published section 4.4 q=3 cell against the CSV at each cell's shown precision.

## Notes

Per @/inv/claims-trace-to-artifacts and @/inv/falsification-preserved; the receipts' section 11.1 record stays regardless (it documents the discrepancy at the time of measurement).
title: Feasibility study table cell disagrees with its own committed CSV
